snippet.title: PHANTOM LAMB - Official Trailer | New Pure Stealth Psychological Horror game (2026)
snippet.description:
Wishlist Phantom Lamb: 
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4075320/Phantom_Lamb/
- Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/phantom-lamb-7779d3 

You have no memory. You have no weapons. And if they catch you... it’s over.

ABOUT THE GAME:

Phantom Lamb is a pure, stealth-only psychological horror experience. You awaken trapped in a decaying, nightmarish asylum with no idea who you are or how you got there. To uncover the truth of your identity, you must escape. But you are not alone.

KEY FEATURES:

- Unforgiving Stealth: No combat. No second chances. Use the shadows, plan your routes, and stay completely silent. If you are caught, you lose.

- A Twisted Mystery: Piece together your shattered memories. Discovering who you are is the only way to understand why you are trapped.

- Suffocating Atmosphere: A terrifying early-20th-century asylum where every creaking floorboard or heavy breath could give away your position
 
Can you escape the madness? Subscribe to Grid Paper Studio for gameplay reveals: @GridPaperStudio
